what: Behind the pill button, a rainbow conic gradient plate (five colors, two loops) spins once every 5 seconds, and on hover it blooms with a 24px blur, .75→1 scale and transparent→visible over .5s while the button shadow deepens. On release it slowly fades out over 2s along the same path (both cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) — the original ease-out class is missing from the css, so Tailwind’s default curve applies)

options.--fx-ease: Bloom and fade-out curve (css), default cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)
options.--fx-c1 ~ --fx-c5: Five colors (css), default is the accent color and four colors rotated from it

use: Say hello
note: CSS only — the angle is rotated with keyframes on @property --fx-cg-angle (original --angle 5s linear). In browsers without @property support the board does not spin and only the blur shows

from.where: shared.css .mp-btn — white pill buttons ”See more” ”Say hello” ”Open work”
